rationale: Secondary Nanog-reporter screen (GeCKOxs, 100 genes): the 25% cells with the lowest Nanog-mCherry were sorted twice; DoubleSorted_Bottom vs Unsorted, two replicates (1 residual df). The DoubleSorted_Top libraries are not used, as the paper compared the low sort with unsorted cells. Counts are raw reads recovered from the deposited normalized table (prepare.R; every library passed with integrality 1.0). Sorted and unsorted libraries of one replicate come from one transduction, so replicate is a blocking term.
